verdict.rationale: Elicit vendor-hosts an interactive Scalar API reference backed by a full OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec (46 paths). Scalar's in-page test console provides a way to run requests. However, the runnable console is only inferred from the client-side mount, not shown working hands-on. It targets the production server only, and API access requires a Pro plan or above. missing for 10: confirmed working in-browser runnable examples, a sandbox or test environment instead of production-only calls, curated example snippets beyond the raw spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Elicit vendor-hosts a Scalar API reference ("Elicit API Reference — Complete API reference for the Elicit research automation platform") embedding the spec.
